notes.title: Modding Support - Update Limitations
notes.notes:
Hey everyone , 

Yesterday I discovered a limitation that unity has regarding the animations. 

Unity does not allow you to make changes to the animation controller in runtime , this means that fully controllable animations will not be present .

Solutions : 

As a result i cant(Unity) allow players to import animations , instead of that i will make a controller for the ramps to “fake” the animation. This comes with some compromises and the fact it's not animation doesn't allow you to make a complex animation with contracting ropes etc. 

All animation situation will have some strict limitations to the names and how to use it in blender or other 3D modeling software except SketchUp(does not keep the hierarchy and pivot points for objects that is very important to solve the animation problem , exports the whole model in one piece and its not good at all )

One more also is will leave a question mark on how a 2 way ramp will work.

I will post soon a video of the progression when I finally deal with this animation problem.

Soon i will uncover more of how to use ramps .
